_comment: Worked example config for humanist.py. This file is DOCUMENTATION, not an install artifact: every value below is invented to show the shape of a key, and copying it verbatim would install someone else's taste as your policy. Copy the keys you actually want into humanist.config.json (auto-loaded from the current directory) or pass it with --config PATH. Keys beginning with an underscore are comments and are ignored.

house._comment_severity_overrides: Keys are RULE IDs, matched EXACTLY. Run `python humanist.py --rules` for the list. An unknown ID or an invalid severity is a hard error, not a silent no-op: the previous version matched by substring, so a key of 'often' silently disabled an unrelated rule, and a typo turned a FAIL into an uncounted note while the run still reported CLEAN. Values: FAIL, WARN, or off.
house._comment_extra_banned_words: Words your house bans outright; every hit is a FAIL. The shipped rule set contains no blanket word bans, because a ban on a common English word is house taste rather than universal law. Invented example: a team that bans a pet adverb.
house._comment_extra_warn_words: Words counted as blanket WARNs so repetition stays visible.
house._comment_never_flag_words: Words no rule may ever flag. This protects a measured tic of the author's real voice from the sweep. Measure your published writing before adding anything here. Invented example: a writer who has confirmed 'basically' is genuinely theirs.
house._comment_extra_ai_vocab: Extra words appended to the tier-1 AI-vocab FAIL list.
house._comment_exempt_patterns: Anchored carve-outs. A hit is suppressed when one of these regexes matches STARTING AT the hit, so the pattern must begin with the flagged phrase. The principle: an empty drum-roll fails, an anchored report survives. Write the straight-apostrophe form; the checker folds curly quotes before matching, which is why text arriving through html2prose.py no longer defeats these.
house._comment_readability: Checked and reported as a WARN, not merely printed. An audience-friction measure, not a voice measure: a real voice at grade 9 beats slop at grade 6. Set check_readability false to skip it entirely.
house._comment_syllable_overrides: Domain acronyms and words the heuristic syllable counter miscounts, merged into the built-in table. Affects the FK grade only.

_comment_markers: The word list --mode post measures per 1,000 words. Replacing this key replaces the whole set rather than extending it, so include the defaults you still want. A register-fingerprint marker (a word class only you use) has to be user-defined; none ships.

band_sets._comment: One band set per register, normally written by `python humanist.py --calibrate <dir> --register <name>`. The entry below documents the shape only. Generate your own; hand-authored bands are somebody's guess about a voice, which is exactly what calibration exists to replace.
